paite: Ka Pathian aw, hon doute a pan hon humbit inla; hon sualte a pan hon humbit in.
heading: Saul In Mi Sawl A David That Dia A-inn A Atan Lai Ua. David La / Bitna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

paite: Thil hihkhialte a pan hon humbit inla, sisan suah hatte a pan hon hondam in.
english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka tatlekna ziak hilou in, ka khelh ziak leng hilou in, ngai in, ka hinna atang gige hi, mihatte hon sual ding in akikhawm uhi.
english: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Yahweh.

paite: Ka khelh louhpi in leng hon sual ding in akisa ua; hon panpih ding in kihihhalh inla, en in.
english: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

paite: TOUPA aw, sepaihte' Pathian, Israel' Pathian, nangmah ngei nam chih gawt ding in thou inla; milepchiah giloutakte peuhmah hawi ke'n. Selah
english: You, Yahweh God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

paite: Nitaklam in ahong nawn ua, ui bang in aham vengvung ua, khopi kimvel ah apai uhi.
english: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

paite: Ngai in akam un asa-ikkhia ua; amuk uah namsaute a-om a, kua athei a-om a! achi maimah uhi.
english: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, nang amau na nuihsan zaw ding a; nam chih na nuihsan ding hi.
english: But you, Yahweh, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

paite: Ahatna ziak in amah ka ngak nilouh ding a, Pathian ka insang ahi ngal a.
english: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

paite: Ka tung a zahngai Pathian in ahon dawn ding a, Pathian in ka melmate tung ah ka thudeih ahon musak ding hi.
english: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

paite: Amau that ke'nla, huchi lou in zaw ka mite'n amangngilh kha ding ua; TOUPA aw, ka phaw pen uh, Na thilhihtheihna in hihdalh inla, hihniam in.
english: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

paite: Akam khelhna ziak un leh amuk ua thupawt ziak in akisaktheihna ngei uah awk uhen; athugen zel uh hamse lohna leh zuauthu ziak in leng.
english: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

paite: Amaute thangpai in hihmangthang inla, a-om nawnlouhna ding un hihmangthang inla, Pathian in Jakobte lak ah vai ahawm chih thei chiat uhen; kawlmong pha in.
english: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

paite: Huan nitaklam in hong uhenla, ui bang in ham vengvung uhenla, khopi kimvel ah pai uhen.
english: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

paite: Amau nek ding zong in avakvak ding ua, atai kei uleh a-om zanhak ding uhi.
english: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

paite: Himahleh ke'n na hatna thu la in ka sa ding a; ahi, zingsang in na zahngaihna thu nuamtak in la in ka sa ding hi; nang ka insang, ka mangbat ni a ka kihumbitna na hi ngal a.
english: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

paite: Ka hatna aw, nang phat in la ka sa ding a; Pathian ka insang, ka tung a siam Pathian ahi ngal a.
english: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
